policy: A meaningful digital suffix can verify an outfit/variant identity when it independently agrees with catalog text. Exact print/texture equivalence still requires visual/component confirmation; later physical releases cannot be source-equivalent.

records.reason: The RedEyes suffix exactly agrees with a physical catalog variant, but that physical release is from 2025, after the 2022 game. This is useful same-variant evidence, not evidence that the physical figure sourced the digital design.
The BlackJacket suffix exactly describes Poe's black-jacket appearance documented for 75189. Variant identity is supported; exact torso/head print reuse remains visual pending.
